title: Betty
tagline: Betty is an AI agent for sports betting with friends on Discord. It creates bets using smart contracts on Arbitrum Stylus, manages deposits via Metamask, and automates payouts with Chainlink results—making group betting seamless and trustless.

prizes.title: Best Use of Arbitrum Stylus for AI Agents

description:
Betty is an AI-powered decentralized application (dApp) designed to facilitate peer-to-peer sports betting on the Arbitrum Stylus blockchain. The project aims to create a trustless and transparent betting ecosystem where users can organize bets, invite friends, and automatically settle outcomes using smart contracts and CDP AgentKit.

Target Audience
- Casual sports bettors who want a trustless and transparent betting experience.
- Web3 enthusiasts interested in decentralized gambling without third-party intermediaries.
- Communities that frequently engage in friendly wagers and want a social, AI-assisted betting experience.
how_its_made: Betty is using Arbitrum Stylus (Rust & WASM) for efficient and low-cost smart contracts, CDP AgentKit for AI-driven interaction within Discord, and Autonome IaaS for decentralized AI infrastructure, ensuring scalability and redundancy. Users engage with Betty through a conversational interface that dynamically generates and deploys smart contracts, enabling trustless peer-to-peer betting with Chainlink oracles fetching match results for automatic payouts.
